integrity: Analytic proof and a reproducible 117-check finite numerical verification are supplied. Numerical tests cannot certify the central limit theorem. No independent review has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The exact distribution at fixed dimension and rates of convergence are not determined. The proof treats regular coordinate cross-polytopes and random hyperplane projections only. An inaccessible relevant recent manuscript leaves residual historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Fourth-harmonic Gaussian fluctuations of random cross-polytope hyperplane shadows
